import { Effect, Schema } from "effect"
import { DepotCode, Parcel, ShipmentId } from "./schema/index.js"

export const Manifest = Schema.Struct({
  shipmentId: ShipmentId,
  origin: DepotCode,
  destination: DepotCode,
  parcels: Schema.Array(Parcel),
  dispatchedAt: Schema.String
})

export type Manifest = typeof Manifest.Type

export const ManifestSummary = Schema.Struct({
  shipmentId: ShipmentId,
  destination: DepotCode,
  parcelCount: Schema.Number
})

export type ManifestSummary = typeof ManifestSummary.Type

export const summarizeManifest = (manifest: Manifest): ManifestSummary => ({
  shipmentId: manifest.shipmentId,
  destination: manifest.destination,
  parcelCount: manifest.parcels.length
})

export const readManifestSummary = (input: unknown) =>
  Schema.decodeUnknownEffect(Manifest)(input).pipe(
    Effect.map(summarizeManifest)
  )
